scope.method: Complete tracked Lean file hash inventory and keyword sweep; source-level review of the selected definitions, proof statements/bodies and primary grammar windows.
scope.proof_status: Pinned source contains the cited proof terms. No fresh upstream compilation or kernel certificate is claimed.
scope.negative_findings_scope: No general new-text nominal feature classifier or complete Arabic cardinal agreement procedure found in the surveyed Lean declarations; this does not claim absence in all branches or all non-Lean files.
scope.source_range_note: Declaration audit windows run from a declaration through the line before the next declaration (or file end), and may contain explanatory comments. Coordinates1-based inclusive; byte coordinates0-based half-open.

contracts.title_ar: المعارف الستة تعداد لا محلل نص
contracts.inputs: A supplied Marifa enum: pronoun, demonstrative, proper name, article-bearing, relative, annexed.
contracts.outputs: A list of six kinds and four distinct external needs.
contracts.proof_scope: marifa_ism proves list length6, four filterMap needs, Nodup, and no need for alam/muarraf; its statement does not contain an IsNoun predicate.
contracts.boundary: No raw-text definiteness extraction; mudaf must be scoped to the relevant definite complement, not arbitrary idafa.

contracts.title_ar: الجنس والعدد في الموصول صفات معطاة
contracts.inputs: Supplied singular/dual/plural and masculine/feminine features plus a list of permitted relative-pronoun readings.
contracts.outputs: Checks membership of an anaphoric feature bundle in allowed bundles and clause completeness.
contracts.proof_scope: General conditional checks and finite witnesses, including multiple readings for man.
contracts.boundary: Agreement compatibility is not acquisition of lexical gender/number, and not a universal nonrational-plural agreement rule.

contracts.title_ar: حصر مرجع الضمير يحفظ تعدد المرشحين
contracts.inputs: Typed input sequence; noun number and gender are inputs (SIFAT_ARE_INPUT). Closed tables contain10 pronouns,5 suffixes,7 relatives.
contracts.outputs: Preceding compatible antecedent candidates; unique/multiple/none result.
contracts.proof_scope: Candidate precedence and compatibility; singleton iff selected; no selection from a nonsingleton candidate list.
contracts.boundary: aidOf matches a cell suffix; it does not prove morphological segmentation. The source does not infer noun features from cells or validate natural-language antecedent truth.

contracts.outputs: General scope, remainder scope, or no judgment; explicit remainder filtering.
contracts.proof_scope: Conditional laws of the declared enum and filter membership; all grammatical/contextual features are already supplied.
contracts.boundary: Do not turn the enum into a parser: article presence alone does not establish genericity; absence does not establish indefiniteness; no automatic universal quantification.

contracts.title_ar: المثنى والجمع والمنقوص أبواب إعراب معلومة مسبقا
contracts.inputs: Supplied noun/verb class (including dual, sound masculine/feminine plural, maqsur, manqus), case and/or abstract visible ending.
contracts.outputs: Abstract ending table and consensus case reader over45 legal class/case pairs.
contracts.proof_scope: read_sound is candidate soundness; read_best needs nonempty unanimous candidates. Coverage5/11/24 is finite model coverage, not text accuracy.
contracts.boundary: No extraction of class from suffix. iManqus abstracts raf/jarr as ya and does not implement every indefinite deletion or pause variant. The table lacks plural lexical admission.

contracts.title_ar: نيابة علامة الجمع لا تثبت صنفه
contracts.inputs: Already typed Qism class plus governor or relation.
contracts.outputs: Alternative ending and case licensing, including sound feminine accusative kasra.
contracts.proof_scope: Finite class checks and general statements about declared governor/relation functions.
contracts.boundary: No new singular/dual/plural or gender inference; idafa_jarr concerns case of complement, not definiteness of the head.

contracts.inputs: A supplied skeleton and root; subsequence matching permits declared weak/hamza variants.
contracts.proof_scope: Theorems prove classifier conditions and partition; examples include فقهاء/أصدقاء/أولياء. ilhaq_named exposes علباء classified as mamduda despite an ilhaq exception.
contracts.boundary: No proof of root truth or nonempty root, no lexical-gender theorem; shape cannot decide the source function. Do not infer feminine referents from a suffix-name.

contracts.title_ar: ساجدين شاهد مخصوص لا قانون جنس عام
contracts.inputs: Finite deposited referent-kind rationality table and observed wawNun/alifTa choice.
contracts.outputs: haqiqa/majaz/no judgment according to source-specific analogy for rational description.
contracts.proof_scope: sajidin is a closed witness; qarinatan_tattafiqan quantifies over deposited rows. haqqJam itself contains only aqil Bool and no grammatical-gender field.
contracts.boundary: Cannot transfer aqil→wawNun and nonaqil→alifTa as a universal plural law. Rational feminine nouns and nonrational masculine nouns require separate axes.

contracts.title_ar: وصف اعتلال الجذر وحراسة الترخيص الصوتي
contracts.inputs: A supplied3-radical root with NoAlif, prescribed form/vowels/prefix/mood; weak is only waw/ya, hamz is distinct.
contracts.outputs: Canonical feature abstraction and transformed templates; phonotactic licensing.
contracts.proof_scope: 250 abstract feature combinations lift to NoAlif roots. madi covers three vowels; mudari/amr babs are the declared bare/FormIV pair. madd_drop_forced is a phonotactic rejection theorem under ajwafSifas.
contracts.boundary: General quantified licensing is not lexical attestation or proof that every possible vowel combination is an Arabic conjugation. No inverse recovery of the root or its lexical bab.

contracts.inputs: Supplied root, one of nine forms I,II,III,IV,V,VI,VII,VIII,X, vowel, prefix and ending.
contracts.outputs: Conditional mithal/hollow/defective transformations and generated cell strings.
contracts.proof_scope: reference_licensed holds over the listed reference roots and allowed parameter lists; other theorems have their own structural scopes.
contracts.boundary: defective is weak-final verbal transformation, not nominal manqus. FormIX is absent; no full lexical/semantic completeness claim.

contracts.title_ar: السطح لا يستعيد واو الجذر أو ياءه وحده
contracts.inputs: Supplied root, template, entry/exit and ending.
contracts.proof_scope: neutral_forgets_weak maps both قول and قيل input roots to the same قال cell sequence; lafif_witnesses explicitly realizes هوى and أحيا.
contracts.boundary: The theorem exhibits a noninjective forward map, not an algorithm that acquires the actual lexical root. Preserve alternatives and origin evidence.

contracts.title_ar: إعادة المحذوف ليست ترخيص الحذف لغويا
contracts.inputs: Explicit cell strings, edit locations/residuals and structural phonotactic hypotheses.
contracts.outputs: Preservation of model admissibility or exact restoration of recorded edits.
contracts.boundary: An inverse edit record preserves information; it does not establish which linguistic edit or lexical reading the input actually has.

contracts.title_ar: جمع التكسير لا تحدده صيغة مفرد واحدة
contracts.inputs: A generated130-row root/singular-pattern/plural-pattern table; reported sound-root, pause-form QAC scope.
contracts.outputs: Pattern-to-pattern candidate functions F/F0 and finite match statistics.
contracts.proof_scope: F0:18/22; after excluding masculine faail F:18/19; خليفة has two plural patterns. triliteral_not_function disproves a universal function of singular pattern alone over this table.
contracts.boundary: Suspended research module. It does not parse new words or prove all broken-plural correspondences. The hamza theorem checks !isVowel on a character, not an explicit sukun annotation. Gender is not recovered.

contracts.title_ar: المصدر القاموسي اختبار محدود لا قانون شامل
contracts.inputs: Deposited lexical rows with supplied root classes and singular/plural patterns.
contracts.proof_scope: W602/609; observed naqis29/29 tafila. F531/749, post-measurement exclusion gives531/595; G136/160.
contracts.boundary: Suspended finite evidence with explicitly post-hoc exclusion; no universal plural generation, gender classifier or equivalence of verbal naqis and nominal manqus.

contracts.title_ar: الأجوف وفعول: اتجاه إحصائي في صفوف معطاة
contracts.inputs: 504 deposited dictionary rows already tagged by RT.
contracts.outputs: Counts156 hollow rows/17 fuul versus202 sound/56 fuul; a strict ratio comparison.
contracts.proof_scope: Finite arithmetic and minimum sample size, not a grammatical impossibility theorem.
contracts.boundary: No root classifier; the result neither excludes fuul from hollow roots nor establishes a productive law.

contracts.title_ar: رفع العلمية في نموذج المنع ليس اكتساب النكرة
contracts.inputs: Supplied semantic/shape flags, including alam, wasf, tanwin and al.
contracts.outputs: Boolean model of prohibition under the declared flags.
contracts.proof_scope: nakira_munsarif explicitly clears alam while assuming no strong cause and no descriptive pair.
contracts.boundary: This theorem does not infer nakira from a token, does not prove all definiteness absent, and does not make tanwin imply indefinite.

contracts.title_ar: عد السلاسل ليس العدد والمعدود في النحو
contracts.inputs: Lists of the116 declared cells with a specific admissibility automaton.
contracts.proof_scope: General model counting and inversion for every length.
contracts.boundary: Not cardinal numeral spelling, noun agreement, grammatical number or counting external objects.

contracts.title_ar: الترقيم العام والمفهوم العددي مجالان آخران
contracts.inputs: Cell strings or pairs of natural numbers.
contracts.boundary: No bridge from code value to counted entities or nominal singular/dual/plural.

contracts.title_ar: مفهوم العدد يستقبل سياقه ولا يحلل صياغته
contracts.inputs: Supplied Qayd.adad context Bool, blockers and a supplied meaning string.
contracts.outputs: Whether a semantic contrary implication is usable under that encoded context.
contracts.proof_scope: General conditional gating and finite quoted witnesses.
contracts.boundary: Not cardinal gender agreement, parsing number expressions or independently discovering the supplied meaning.
